content.short: Syndica provides indexing APIs, RPC infrastructure, and the ChainStream API for on-chain data.
content.description: Syndica delivers enterprise-grade on-chain infrastructure across major networks such as Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain. It combines specialized indexing APIs, scalable RPC infrastructure, and the ChainStream API for streaming on-chain events. You gain access to on-chain data through battle-tested RPC services and the ChainStream API, providing real-time notifications of on-chain activity so your applications can respond quickly and reliably at scale. This infrastructure supports building responsive apps, analytics dashboards, and alerting systems with confidence.
content.meta: Syndica offers Web3 infrastructure with indexing APIs, RPC infrastructure, and the ChainStream API. Discover Syndica and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
